plugin.name: SlopeTrain
plugin.author: Kanaye
plugin.purpose: A plugin to help you lead a slope train

muclient.script:
require("wait") require("async") json = require("json")
plugin_url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/st3rv1s/SlopeTrain/refs/heads/main/SlopeTrain.xml" SetVariable("DownloadURL", plugin_url) plugin_protocol = "HTTPS" plugin_prefix = "[SlopeTrain]"
function update_check_alias() update_plugin("check") ColourNote("white", "", plugin_prefix .. " Checking for updated version...") end
function update_install_alias() update_plugin("install") ColourNote("white", "", plugin_prefix .. " Checking for and installing updated version...") end
function reload_plugin() local scriptPrefix = GetAlphaOption("script_prefix") local retval
-- If the user has not already specified the script prefix for this version of mush, pick a -- reasonable default value if scriptPrefix == "" then scriptPrefix = "\\\\\\" SetAlphaOption("script_prefix", scriptPrefix) end
-- Tell mush to reload the plugin in one second. We can't do it directly here because a -- plugin can't unload itself. Even if it could, how could it tell mush to load it again -- if it weren't installed? retval = Execute(scriptPrefix .. "DoAfterSpecial(0.1, \"ReloadPlugin('" .. GetPluginID() .. "')\", sendto.script)") end
function update_plugin(mode) update_mode = mode
wait.make(get_plugin_file) end
function get_plugin_file() local urlThread = async.request(plugin_url, plugin_protocol)
if not urlThread then note_error("Couldn't create async url request.") return end
local timeout = 10 local totTime = 0 while urlThread:alive() and totTime < timeout do wait.time(0.1) totTime = totTime + 0.1 end
local remoteRet, pluginData, status, headers, fullStatus = urlThread:join()
if not status then ColourNote("red", "", plugin_prefix .. " Couldn't download plugin file. No status code.")
return end
if status ~= 200 then ColourNote("red", "", plugin_prefix .. " Plugin file request status code: " .. status .. ": " .. fullStatus) return end
local currentVersion = GetPluginInfo(GetPluginID(), 19) or 0 local currentVerStr = string.format("%1.3f", currentVersion) local remoteVerStr = string.match(pluginData, '%s%s+version="([0-9%.]+)"') local remoteVersion = tonumber(remoteVerStr or "") or 0
if remoteVersion == currentVersion then ColourNote("white", "", plugin_prefix .. " You are running the most recent version (v" .. currentVerStr .. ")") elseif remoteVersion < currentVersion then ColourNote( "white", "", plugin_prefix .. " You have a newer version than is publicly available. (v" .. currentVerStr .. ")" ) elseif update_mode == "check" then ColourNote( "white", "", plugin_prefix .. " You are running v" .. currentVerStr .. ", but there's a newer version v" .. remoteVerStr ) elseif update_mode == "install" then ColourNote( "white", "", plugin_prefix .. " Updating plugin from version " .. currentVerStr .. " to version " .. remoteVerStr )
local pluginFile = GetPluginInfo(GetPluginID(), 6) local file = io.open(pluginFile, "wb") file:write(pluginData) file:close() reload_plugin() else ColourNote("red", "", plugin_prefix .. " Invalid update mode: " .. update_mode) end end ----------------------- End Plugin Update Code -----------------------
-- Ensure the gmcphelper module is loaded require("gmcphelper")
-- Load the Aardwolf color functions dofile(GetInfo(60) .. "aardwolf_colors.lua")
-- Basic print function that supports Aardwolf, xterm, and ANSI color codes function cnote(string) AnsiNote(stylesToANSI(ColoursToStyles(string))) end
-- Show the helpfile after installing or loading the plugin function OnPluginInstall() show_helpfile()
local saved_msgs = GetVariable("train_msg") if saved_msgs then local ok, decoded = pcall(json.decode, saved_msgs) if ok and type(decoded) == "table" and #decoded > 0 then train_msg = decoded else train_msg = { "@C(@DSlopeTrain@C) Default message moving @C%s@W!$C" } end else train_msg = { "@C(@DSlopeTrain@C) Default message moving @C%s@W!$C" } end end
is_group_leader = false player_name = "" room_num = 0 current_zone = "" in_combat = false on_slope = false slope_repop_enabled = true chan = GetVariable("chan") or "gtell"
slope_directions = { slingshot = "enter slingshot", kill = "west", hatchery = "east", chutes = "south", }
slope_exits = { west = 38836, east = 38814, south = 38825, }
slope_rooms = {}
for i = 38814, 38845 do if i ~= 38824 and i ~= 38835 then slope_rooms[i] = true end end
local status, result = pcall(json.decode, GetVariable("train_msg")) if status and type(result) == "table" then train_msg = result else Note("[SlopeTrain] No saved train messages located. Using defaults. Customize them with 'slopetrain set msg'.") train_msg = { "@C(@DSlopeTrain@C) @x256CHOO @x256CHOO@W, the train is moving @C%s@W!$C", "@C(@DSlopeTrain@C) @WALL ABOARD! The train is moving @C%s@W... @x256CHOO @x256CHOO@W!$C", } SetVariable("train_msg", json.encode(train_msg)) end
-- Helper to fill all %s placeholders with the same value function repeat_sprintf(template, value) return template:gsub("%%s", value) end
function OnPluginBroadcast(msg, id, name, text) if id == "3e7dedbe37e44942dd46d264" then if text == "char.base" then player_name = gmcp("char.base.name") elseif text == "group" then is_group_leader = (gmcp("group.leader") == gmcp("char.base.name")) elseif text == "room.info" then room_num = tonumber(gmcp("room.info.num")) is_in_icefall = (gmcp("room.info.zone") == "icefall") on_enter_room() elseif text == "char.status" then local status = gmcp("char.status") local state = tonumber(status.state) in_combat = (state == 8) end end end
function on_enter_room() on_slope = slope_rooms[room_num] or false end
function enter_slope(name, line, wildcards) if in_combat then Note("[SlopeTrain] You're in combat. Movement blocked.") return end
local direction = name last_slope_direction = direction
if is_in_icefall and room_num ~= 38813 then Execute("mapper goto 38813")
wait.make(function() while tonumber(gmcp("room.info.num")) ~= 38813 do wait.time(1) end
-- pause at pinnacle wait.time(1)
continue_slope_entry(direction) end)
return end
continue_slope_entry(direction) end
function continue_slope_entry(direction) if is_group_leader then SendNoEcho(direction)
wait.make(function() local timeout = 1 local elapsed = 0 local dir
while elapsed < timeout do dir = get_slope_direction(room_num) if dir then break end
wait.time(0.2) elapsed = elapsed + 0.2 end
if dir then slope_success(dir) else Note("[SlopeTrain] Timed out waiting for valid slope entry.") end end) else SendNoEcho(direction:lower()) end end
function get_slope_direction(room) for dir, num in pairs(slope_exits) do if num == room then return dir end end return nil end
function move_next_slope_room() if not on_slope then Note("[SlopeTrain] You are not on the slope.") return end
local exits = gmcp("room.info.exits") if not exits or type(exits) ~= "table" then Note("[SlopeTrain] No exits found in GMCP.") return end
local count, dir = 0, nil for k, v in pairs(exits) do count = count + 1 dir = k end
if count == 1 and dir then if dir == "down" then Note("[SlopeTrain] You’ve reached the END of the slope. Use commands to move to new slope.") return -- stop here, don’t auto-move else SendNoEcho(dir) end else Note("[SlopeTrain] Unexpected number of exits (" .. count .. ").") end end
function slope_success(direction) -- Use repeat_sprintf so all %s get the same direction local slope_msg = repeat_sprintf(train_msg[math.random(1, #train_msg)], direction:upper()) last_train_msg = slope_msg SendNoEcho(chan .. " " .. slope_msg) end
function follow_the_leader(name, line, wildcards) if wildcards[1] == gmcp("group.leader") then SendNoEcho(slope_directions[name]) end end
function expired_pass_action() local current_pass = GetVariable("current_pass") or "onedaypass"
Execute("mapper goto 38714")
if current_pass == "250usespass" then SendNoEcho("buy 250usespass") elseif current_pass == "oneweekpass" then SendNoEcho("buy oneweekpass") elseif current_pass == "onedaypass" then SendNoEcho("buy onedaypass") end
SendNoEcho("keyring put pass") Execute("mapper goto 38813")
wait.make(function() while tonumber(gmcp("room.info.num")) ~= 38813 do wait.time(1) end
if last_slope_direction then continue_slope_entry(last_slope_direction) last_slope_direction = nil end end) end
function set_slope_message() local messages = utils.editbox( "Custom slope messages.\nUse %s as a substitute for direction.\nOne custom message per line.\nTo prevent color bleeding end with $C.", "Slope Notifications", table.concat(train_msg, "\r\n") )
if not messages then Note("[SlopeTrain] No custom messages or user cancelled. Keeping existing messages.") return end
local new_messages = {} for line in messages:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do table.insert(new_messages, line) end
if #new_messages == 0 then Note("[SlopeTrain] No messages entered. Reverting to default messages.") new_messages = { "@C(@DSlopeTrain@C) @x256CHOO @x256CHOO@W, the train is moving @C%s@W!$C", "@C(@DSlopeTrain@C) @WALL ABOARD! The train moving @C%s@W... @x256CHOO @x256CHOO@W!$C" } end
train_msg = new_messages SetVariable("train_msg", json.encode(train_msg)) -- ✅ JSON-safe, keeps symbols intact Note("[SlopeTrain] Saved custom messages.") end
function set_channel(name, line, wildcards) SetVariable("chan", wildcards[1]) cnote("@b[SlopeTrain] Changed report channel to:@C " .. wildcards[1]) end
last_train_msg = nil
function repeat_train_direction() if not is_in_icefall then Note("[SlopeTrain] You can only repeat directions in Icefall.") return end
if last_train_msg then SendNoEcho("gtell " .. last_train_msg) Note("[SlopeTrain] Repeating last direction") else Note("[SlopeTrain] No previous direction to repeat.") end end
function toggle_pass_type() local current_pass = GetVariable("current_pass") or "onedaypass" local pass_ids = {"250usespass", "oneweekpass", "onedaypass"} local current_index = 0
for i, pass in ipairs(pass_ids) do if pass == current_pass then current_index = i break end end
local next_index = (current_index % #pass_ids) + 1 local next_pass = pass_ids[next_index] SetVariable("current_pass", next_pass)
local display_formats = { ["250usespass"] = "@W[@G250 Uses @RPass@W]", oneweekpass = "@W[@COne Week @RPass@W]", onedaypass = "@W[@yOne Day @RPass@W]" }
cnote(string.format("@b[SlopeTrain] Pass type toggled. Current pass type: %s", display_formats[next_pass])) end
function show_current_pass() local current_pass = GetVariable("current_pass") or "onedaypass"
local display_formats = { ["250usespass"] = "@W[@G250 Uses @RPass@W]", oneweekpass = "@W[@COne Week @RPass@W]", onedaypass = "@W[@yOne Day @RPass@W]" }
cnote(string.format("@b[SlopeTrain] Current pass type: %s", display_formats[current_pass] or current_pass)) end
function toggle_slope_repop() if slope_repop_enabled then slope_repop_enabled = false EnableGroup("slopeRepop", false) cnote("@b[SlopeTrain]Repop message is now @ROFF") else slope_repop_enabled = true EnableGroup("slopeRepop", true) cnote("@b[SlopeTrain]Repop message is now @GON") end end
function slope_repop() if not chan or chan == "" then ColourNote("red", "", "SlopeTrain: Channel is not set. Use 'slopetrain channel' to set one.") return end
if is_group_leader then SendNoEcho(chan .. " @C(@x244SlopeTrain@C) @WThe engine just got @GFUELED@W. @x256C@x256H@x256U@x256G@x256G@x256A @x256C@x256H@x256U@x256G@x256G@x256A @x256C@x256H@x256O@x256O @x256C@x256H@x256O@x256O$C") end end
function show_helpfile() cnote("") cnote("@C+@W-------------------[@CSlopeTrain Helpfile@W]--------------------@C+@w") ColourNote("white", "", "", "white", "", "") ColourNote("lightcyan", "", "slopetrain update check - ", "white", "", "Check your current version") ColourNote("lightcyan", "", "slopetrain update install - ", "white", "", "Install latest version") ColourNote("lightcyan", "", "slopetrain help - ", "white", "", "Outputs this helpfile") ColourNote("white", "", "", "white", "", "") cnote("@C+@W-------------------[@CSlopeTrain Setup@W]------------------------@C+@w") ColourNote("white", "", "", "white", "", "") ColourNote("lightcyan", "", "slopetrain set msg - ", "white", "", "Setup your own slope mesesages") ColourNote("lightcyan", "", "slopetrain set pass - ", "white", "", "Toggle between type of pass") ColourNote("lightcyan", "", "slopetrain show pass - ", "white", "", "Shows your current set pass") ColourNote("lightcyan", "", "slopetrain repop - ", "white", "", "Turn on/off the repop message") ColourNote("lightcyan", "", "slopetrain channel - ", "white", "", "Set repop channel: ", "cyan", "", chan) ColourNote("white", "", "", "white", "", "") cnote("@C+@W-------------------[@CSlopeTrain Commands@W]---------------------@C+@w") ColourNote("white", "", "", "white", "", "") ColourNote("lightcyan", "", "icee - ", "white", "", "Move the train to the East slope") ColourNote("lightcyan", "", "ices - ", "white", "", "Move the train to the South slope") ColourNote("lightcyan", "", "icew - ", "white", "", "Move the train to the West slope") ColourNote("lightcyan", "", "icenxt - ", "white", "", "To move to the next room on slope") ColourNote("lightcyan", "", "repdir - ", "white", "", "Manually report the last direction") ColourNote("white", "", "", "white", "", "") cnote("@C+@W-------------------[@CSlopeTrain Helpfile@W]---------------------@C+@w") cnote("") end

trigger.match: ^([^ ]+) enters a gigantic slingshot, ready for another trip down the Avalanche Slalom!$
trigger.name: slingshot
ExpiredPass
trigger.match: ^A gruff ski patrol destroys your expired pass\!|You must have a ski pass in order to enter the powerup slopes\.$

trigger.name: Repop
trigger.match: ^The Avalanche Slalom is covered with dry powder snow\.$
